text:
Maya: Quick huddle 1 Syndicate just formalized a pilot ask: per-tenant KMS (customer-managed) + eventual HSM attestation, and a tight p99 latency target. Need to align scope + launch criteria across teams.
Priya: Can we see the exact ask? Sales shared a short doc but I want the bullet version.
Maya: From the doc: "Pilot: isolated capacity, customer-managed KMS for keys, target p95 200ms / p99 350ms for 2k-token text-gen. Full HSM + p99 150ms is roadmap post-pilot."
Alex: Infra perspective: we can reserve a dedicated GPU shard and set up a KMS connector quickly. HSM integration (attestation + cert rotation + audit exports) is ~3-4 weeks. Network peering + IAM scoping are blockers too.
Jordan: Security: customer requires SOC2-aligned evidence for key custody. We can do customer-managed KMS for pilot but must not claim HSM equivalence. HSM attestation needs vendor coordination and some legal review.
Sam: Runtime: 2k tokens at p99 150ms is unrealistic on current model families. For pilot we can offer a smaller model variant or tune quantization + batching to hit p95 targets. Need experiments on latency tail and cache warmup.
Lee: Product suggestion: MVP pilot = customer-managed KMS + soft SLAs (p95 target) + clear migration path to HSM & hard SLAs. Capture acceptance criteria: perf eval, telemetry, and a rollback plan.
Priya: Customer timeline: they asked for a pilot in ~8 weeks. If HSM is a hard requirement that's out; for customer-managed KMS + dedicated capacity maybe doable if we parallelize.
Maya: Sounds like consensus: pilot scope = customer-managed KMS, dedicated capacity, soft SLA, no HSM attestation. Post-pilot plan = HSM + tight p99 SLA.
Sam: Concrete runtime actions: run perf matrix for model A/B at max sequence (2048), quantize A/B, test KV cache warmup, measure p95/p99 under realistic QPS. I'll own this. ETA: 2 weeks for initial runs.
Alex: Infra actions: draft infra runbook (peering, vpc, dedicated pools), KMS connector plan, audit-logging path. I'll open infra tickets and a PRD. ETA: 10 business days for pilot prep.
Jordan: Security actions: gap analysis vs SOC2 for pilot (what evidence we can provide), legal checklist for claims about key custody. I'll work with compliance. ETA: end of next week.
Priya: I'll negotiate scope with the customer: push for dedicated capacity commitment and flexible SLA language for pilot. I'll also get them to agree to using their KMS for pilot.
Maya: Risks: 1) perf regressions from quantization causing quality issues; 2) HSM delays pushing full-contract timelines; 3) perf SLOs slipping under real load. Mitigations: eval harness + migration plan + fallback model.
Lee: Evals: I'll run a quality regression suite whenever quant configs change. Link to eval harness: https://redwood.internal/evals/syndicate (internal).
deploy-bot: New ticket created: PROD-8342 "Syndicate pilot preflight" assigned to Alex.
Maya: Action owners recap: Maya -> coordinate legal & sales messaging; Priya -> customer comms & scope; Alex -> infra runbook & tickets; Sam -> runtime perf tests; Jordan -> security/compliance gap doc; Lee -> evals.
Sam: One more: can we define measurable launch criteria? Proposing: 1) p95 <= 200ms on pilot traffic shape; 2) quality delta <= 2% in eval suite; 3) audit logs available for last 30 days; 4) infra provisioning checklist green.
Jordan: Agreed but add: explicit language about HSM attestation not ready for pilot. Legal ok?
Maya: I'll confirm wording with Legal and post the final acceptance criteria doc by EOD Friday. Weekly sync next Monday same time.
Priya: I'll draft customer-facing pilot scope and send to Sales + Legal for sign-off.
Alex: I'll drop the infra PRD link in this thread once ready.
Maya: Thanks everyone 1 I'll capture decisions in the initiative doc and ping owners if things slip.
